notes.title: Please VR - Developer Let's Play
notes.notes:
Stream for developer's lets play - feel free to drop any questions, I'll be answering throughout the stream!

Please is a VR Narrative Rhythm Bullet Hell game, inspired by many of the different rhythm games in history like DJ Max, Elite Beat Agents, Crypt of the Necrodancer, Taiko, etc. and bullet hell boss fights from games like UT.

Please wishlist our game if you like it or follow our progress at: [url=https://discord.gg/cYQvCbm]https://discord.gg/cYQvCbm[/url]

Thank you!
